import semver
import argparse

# Test createparser
parser = semver.createparser()

print(f'finalize_version result: {result}')

# Test process with bump
args = argparse.Namespace(which='bump', bump='major', version='1.2.3')
result = semver.process(args)
print(f'process(bump) result: {result}')

# Test process with compare
args = argparse.Namespace(which='compare', version1='1.0.0', version2='2.0.0')
result = semver.process(args)
print(f'process(compare) result: {result}')

# Test process with check
args = argparse.Namespace(which='check', version='1.0.0')
result = semver.process(args)
print(f'process(check) result: {result}')
"
